visual_action: A slow-motion shot of Joe Biden wearing a suit and aviator sunglasses, walking towards the camera outdoors on what appears to be a deck. A text overlay from Bloomberg is displayed over the lower part of the screen.

cast.name: Joe Biden
cast.evidence: Joe Biden is the only person shown on screen for the entire video. The on-screen text explicitly names him.

cast.name: Eli Lilly
cast.evidence: The on-screen headline states 'Eli Lilly Caps Out-of-Pocket Insulin Costs at $35'.

cast.name: Bloomberg
cast.evidence: The word 'Bloomberg' is displayed at the top of the text overlay, citing it as the source of the headline.

on_screen_text.text: Heeding Biden, Eli Lilly Caps Out-of-Pocket Insulin Costs at $35

spoken_summary: There is no dialogue in this video; only music plays.
audio_music: A slowed and reverbed version of the electronic song 'Midnight City' by M83 plays throughout, creating a triumphant, cool, and epic tone.
editing_pacing: The video consists of a single, continuous slow-motion shot.
cultural_references: The video uses a slowed and reverbed version of the song 'Midnight City' by M83.
The visual aesthetic of Joe Biden in aviator sunglasses, walking confidently in slow-motion, evokes the 'Dark Brandon' internet meme.
central_claim: President Biden is an effective leader whose policies have successfully pressured pharmaceutical companies like Eli Lilly to lower insulin costs for Americans.
intended_effect: To make the viewer feel proud of President Biden's accomplishments and view him as a cool and effective leader.
